input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜：在墓地玩，在Place V.; 装着祭拜的样子

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 喜欢玩在墓地里：喜欢在墓地里玩，A location phrase such as “在墓地里” normally comes before the main verb “玩.”
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 装祭拜：假装祭拜，“假装” can be followed by an action to mean pretending to do it; “装祭拜” is not a natural verb-object expression.
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子小的时候：有一个小男孩叫孟子，他，This is the character’s first mention, so introduce him with a full noun phrase before using a pronoun.
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和他的朋友：他和朋友，Use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence of the already mentioned character; “朋友” was also mentioned in the previous sentence.
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子五岁的时候：他五岁的时候，Use a pronoun when the same character was named in the immediately preceding sentence.
6. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 跟妈妈搬家：跟妈妈搬了家，Use “了” for the completed moving event in the narrative.

items.reason: 地点短语“在墓地里”应放在动词“玩”之前。
“装祭拜”搭配不自然，“假装祭拜”可以正确表达这个意思。
首次出现孟子需要介绍，但该替换删掉了“小的时候”，并形成不完整、不自然的句子结构。
孟子刚在前句出现，按教师的指代规则应使用“他”。
孟子在紧邻的前句已经出现，此处应使用近距离指代“他”。
搬家是叙述中已经完成的事件，需要用完成体“搬了家”。
